人教版必修第一册 · 第二章第二节「大气热力环流」（p.36–38）、导入《台海: PEP Geography Required Book 1 · Ch. 2 Sec. 2 "Atmospheric Thermal Circulation" (pp.36–38), introduction from Records of a Mission to Taiwan (p.34)
温差 → 升降 → 气压差 → 风 → 环流: Temperature difference → rising/sinking → pressure difference → wind → circulation
台湾海峡两岸的风向，为什么一天里会反过来？: Why does the wind across the Taiwan Strait reverse within a single day?
地面冷热不均：A 受热多，B、C 受热少: Uneven surface heating: A is heated more, B and C less
A 上方空气上升，B、C 上方空气下沉: Air rises above A and sinks above B and C
同一水平面出现气压差：上层 A 高、B 与 C 低: Pressure differences on the same level: aloft, A is high and B and C are low
空气由高压流向低压：高空出 A，近地面回 A: Air flows from high to low pressure: out of A aloft, back to A near the surface
七支首尾相接成两胞环流 → 海陆风、城市热岛: Seven branches join end to end into two circulation cells → sea–land breeze, urban heat island
剖面左边那一段地面（抽象场景是 B 地，海陆是陆地，城郊是郊区）: The left section of ground in the cross-section (B in the abstract scene, land in sea–land, suburb in city–suburb)
剖面中间那一段地面（抽象场景是 A 地，城郊是中心区，海陆是岸线）: The middle section of ground in the cross-section (A in the abstract scene, city center in city–suburb, shoreline in sea–land)
剖面右边那一段地面（抽象场景是 C 地，海陆是海洋，城郊是郊区）: The right section of ground in the cross-section (C in the abstract scene, ocean in sea–land, suburb in city–suburb)
环流顶附近：气流由 A 上空分头流向 B、C 上空: Near the top of the circulation: air splits from above A toward above B and C
贴地的一层：气流由 B、C 流回 A: The layer next to the ground: air flows from B and C back to A
地面一样热的时候，空气会自己绕着走吗？: When the ground is equally warm, does air circulate on its own?
把「温差」从 0 拖到 5 K：看 A 段的空气开始上升、B 和 C 段开始下沉: Drag "Temperature difference" from 0 to 5 K: watch air over A start to rise while air over B and C starts to sink
温差 0 时风速 0.0 m/s、气压差 0.00 hPa；拖到 5 K 后风速: At ΔT 0 the wind is 0.0 m/s and the pressure difference 0.00 hPa; at 5 K the wind is 4.6 m/s and the pressure difference 1.03 hPa, a red air column with an upward arrow rises over A, and downward arrows appear over B and C
ΔT > 0 → A 升、B、C 沉: ΔT > 0 → A rises, B and C sink
受热均匀：没有相对升降: Even heating: no relative rising or sinking
受热不均：开始升降: Uneven heating: rising and sinking begin
大气运动有垂直运动和水平运动之分：垂直运动表现为气流上升或下沉，水平运动即是风。: Atmospheric motion is either vertical or horizontal: vertical motion appears as rising or sinking air, and horizontal motion is wind.
当地面受热均匀时，空气没有相对上升和相对下沉运动（教材图 2.11a 画的就是这: When the ground is heated evenly, air has no relative rising or sinking (Fig. 2.11a shows exactly this state: all four isobaric surfaces are flat).
一旦 A 接受热量多、B 和 C 接受热量少，A 地近地面空气膨胀上升、B 和: Once A receives more heat and B and C less, near-surface air at A expands and rises while air at B and C contracts and sinks; in the reference case with a 5 K difference the near-surface wind is 4.6 m/s.
去掉这一步：学生会跳过「起因」直接背环流图，说不出这个圈为什么会出现。: Skip this step and students jump past the cause and memorize the circulation diagram without being able to say why the loop appears.
常考：热力环流的成因是地面冷热不均，不是地转偏向力。: Often tested: thermal circulation is caused by uneven surface heating, not by the Coriolis force.
地面受热均匀时没有相对上升和下沉；地面冷热不均是热力环流的起因——A 地受热多，: With even heating there is no relative rising or sinking; uneven heating is the cause of thermal circulation: A is heated more and its air expands and rises, B and C are heated less and their air contracts and sinks.
facts A2.1、A2.2 第 1 条、A2.8（图 2.11a/b 图面）: facts A2.1, A2.2 item 1, A2.8 (Fig. 2.11a/b), B2.1 items 1–3, table rows 1–2
空气升上去以后，为什么分头往两边跑？: Once the air has risen, why does it split toward both sides?
点一下画面上方那支蓝色的「高空水平气流」箭头：三个高空的气压标签一起亮起来: Click the blue "upper-air horizontal flow" arrow at the top: the three upper-air pressure labels light up together
At the same altitude aloft: above A 899.70 hPa (high), above B and C 898.75 hPa (low), a difference of 0.95 hPa; two arrows point from above A toward above B and C
A 地近地面空气膨胀上升，到上空聚积，使上空空气密度增大，形成高气压。: Near-surface air at A expands and rises, accumulates aloft and raises the air density there, forming high pressure.
B、C 两地空气收缩下沉，上空空气密度减小，形成低气压。: Air at B and C contracts and sinks, so the air density above them decreases, forming low pressure.
于是空气从气压高的 A 地上空向气压低的 B、C 两地上空扩散；教材图 2.11: So air spreads from the high pressure above A toward the low pressure above B and C; Fig. 2.11b draws exactly this (high above A, low above B and C).
去掉这一步：学生会把「气压差」当成地面上的事，画不出环流的上半圈。: Skip this step and students treat the pressure difference as a ground-level matter and cannot draw the upper half of the loop.
易错：以为受热处上空也是低压。受热处是「近地面低压、上空高压」。: Common mistake: thinking the air above the heated area is also low pressure. The heated area has low pressure near the surface and high pressure aloft.
受热处上空空气聚积、密度增大形成高气压，未受热处上空密度减小形成低气压；高空气流: Above the heated area air accumulates and density rises to form high pressure; above the unheated areas density falls to form low pressure; upper-air flow goes from above the heated area toward above the unheated areas.
facts A2.2 第 2、4 条、A2.8（图 2.11b 图面）、B2.1: facts A2.2 items 2 and 4, A2.8 (Fig. 2.11b), B2.1 item 2, table row 1
贴地这一层，气压怎么反过来了？: Why is the pressure reversed in the layer next to the ground?
点一下 A 段近地面那个「低」字标签：看同一段上下两个标签正好相反、近地面那条等: Click the "Low" label near the surface over A: see that the two labels on the same section are opposite, and the near-surface isobaric surface dips here
近地面：A 地 1012.22 hPa（低）、B 和 C 地 1013.25 h: Near the surface: A 1012.22 hPa (low), B and C 1013.25 hPa (high), a difference of 1.03 hPa; the near-surface isobaric surface is 8.1 m lower at A and the upper one is 8.7 m higher above A
p(A 近地面) < p(B、C 近地面): p(A near surface) < p(B, C near surface)
上下两层符号相反: Upper and lower layers have opposite signs
等压面：近地面下凹 · 高空上凸: Isobaric surfaces: dip near the surface · bulge aloft
在近地面，A 地空气上升向外流出后，空气密度减小，形成低气压。: Near the surface, after the air at A rises and flows outward, the air density decreases, forming low pressure.
At B and C sinking air increases the air density, forming high pressure (reference case: A 1012.22 hPa, B and C 1013.25 hPa).
同一段地面上下两层的气压符号正好相反，所以等压面在 A 处近地面下凹、在高空上凸: The pressure signs of the upper and lower layers over the same section are exactly opposite, so the isobaric surface dips near the surface at A and bulges aloft; Fig. 2.11b/c draws exactly this bending.
去掉这一步：学生会以为上下两层气压同号，环流就闭合不起来。: Skip this step and students assume both layers have the same pressure sign, so the circulation can't close.
易错：把「上升」理解成「空气变多所以气压高」。近地面是低压，因为空气上升后向外流: Common mistake: reading "rising" as "more air, so higher pressure". Near the surface it is low pressure, because the rising air flows away.
受热处近地面空气上升向外流出、密度减小形成低气压，未受热处因下沉气流形成高气压；: Near-surface air over the heated area rises and flows out, lowering density to form low pressure; the unheated areas form high pressure because of sinking air; the upper and lower layers of the same section have opposite pressure signs.
facts A2.2 第 3 条、A2.3、A2.8（图 2.11b/c 图面）: facts A2.2 item 3, A2.3, A2.8 (Fig. 2.11b/c), B2.1 items 2 and 4, table row 1
空气走完一圈，为什么能自己接上？: Why does the air's path join up into a full loop on its own?
点一下贴地那支红色的「近地面水平气流」箭头：七支箭头首尾相接，两个环亮起来: Click the red "near-surface horizontal flow" arrow next to the ground: seven arrows join end to end and two loops light up
近地面风由 B、C 吹向 A，高空风由 A 分头吹向 B、C，两支方向相反；风速: Near-surface wind blows from B and C toward A, upper-air wind from A out to B and C, in opposite directions; wind speed 4.6 m/s; the seven arrows form two closed loops, left and right
近地面：B、C → A；高空：A → B、C: Near surface: B, C → A; aloft: A → B, C
方向由高压指向低压 · 参考工况: Direction from high pressure to low pressure · reference case
由高压流向低压: Flow from high to low pressure
七支首尾相接: Seven branches join end to end
近地面的空气从 B、C 两地流回 A 地，以补充 A 地上升的空气，从而形成了热: Near-surface air flows from B and C back to A to replace the rising air at A, forming the thermal circulation.
方向判据只有一句话：空气由高压区流向低压区（水平气压梯度力是形成风的直接原因）。: The direction rule is a single sentence: air flows from high pressure to low pressure (the horizontal pressure gradient force is the direct cause of wind).
所以同一个环里，高空与近地面两支的水平方向必然相反（点积 = −1）。: So within one loop, the upper and near-surface branches must flow in opposite horizontal directions (dot product = −1).
去掉这一步：只剩几支断开的箭头，「环流」这个词落不了地，海陆风和热岛环流也无从谈: Skip this step and only a few disconnected arrows remain; the word "circulation" never takes shape, and sea–land breezes and heat-island circulation can't be explained.
常考：先有垂直运动，再出现同一水平面的气压差，最后才有水平运动——顺序不能倒。: Often tested: vertical motion comes first, then pressure differences on the same level, and only then horizontal motion; the order cannot be reversed.
近地面空气由未受热处流回受热处，与上升、高空扩散、下沉一起构成闭合的热力环流；高: Near-surface air flows from the unheated areas back to the heated area and, together with rising, spreading aloft and sinking, forms a closed thermal circulation; the upper and near-surface flows are opposite, by the rule "from high to low pressure".
facts A2.2 第 4、5 条、A2.4、A2.8（图 2.11c 图面）: facts A2.2 items 4 and 5, A2.4, A2.8 (Fig. 2.11c), B2.1 item 5
温差再大一点，这个圈会怎样？: With a larger temperature difference, what happens to the loop?
把温差从 5 K 拖到 10 K：看两个环变粗、等压面弯得更厉害: Drag the temperature difference from 5 K to 10 K: watch both loops thicken and the isobaric surfaces bend more
气压差 1.03 → 2.02 hPa，气压梯度 5.1 → 10.1 hPa/: Pressure difference 1.03 → 2.02 hPa, pressure gradient 5.1 → 10.1 hPa/100 km, wind 4.6 → 6.5 m/s; isobaric dip at A 8.1 → 16.3 m
三格读数是一条因果链: The three readings form one causal chain
温差越大，同一高度上的气压差越大：1.03 → 2.02 hPa。: The larger the temperature difference, the larger the pressure difference at the same altitude: 1.03 → 2.02 hPa.
气压梯度随之增大（5.1 → 10.1 hPa/100 km），近地面风也变强（: The pressure gradient rises with it (5.1 → 10.1 hPa/100 km), and the near-surface wind strengthens (4.6 → 6.5 m/s).
这三格读数是同一条因果链上的三个环节，不是三个独立结论。: These three readings are three links in the same causal chain, not three separate conclusions.
去掉这一步：学生只知道「有环流」，不知道环流的强弱由什么决定。: Skip this step and students only know "there is a circulation", not what decides its strength.
常考：气压梯度是「单位距离间的气压差」；等压线越密，气压梯度越大，风越大。: Often tested: the pressure gradient is the pressure difference per unit distance; the denser the isobars, the larger the gradient and the stronger the wind.
温差是环流强弱的源头：温差越大，同一高度的气压差越大、气压梯度越大、风越大。: The temperature difference is the source of circulation strength: the larger it is, the larger the pressure difference at the same altitude, the larger the pressure gradient and the stronger the wind.
facts A2.4、B2.1 第 3 条、表 1 与表 3 行、D6、D7: facts A2.4, B2.1 item 3, table rows 1 and 3, D6, D7
台湾海峡白天吹的是哪个方向的风？: Which way does the wind blow across the Taiwan Strait in the daytime?
看 10 秒：教材图 2.13a 是一张留白的图，这里按活动第 1 题的四小问一: Watch for 10 seconds: textbook Fig. 2.13a is a blank diagram; here it is drawn layer by layer following the four parts of Activity question 1: temperature → vertical motion → pressure → horizontal motion
陆地（左）暖、海洋（右）冷；陆地上空上升、海洋上空下沉；近地面风由海吹向陆；风速: Land (left) warm, ocean (right) cool; air rises over land and sinks over the ocean; near-surface wind blows from sea to land; wind 4.6 m/s, pressure difference 1.03 hPa
白天：陆地增温快 → 海风（海 → 陆）: Daytime: land warms faster → sea breeze (sea → land)
陆地增温快、海洋增温慢: Land warms fast, ocean warms slowly
四层顺序照活动要求: Four layers in the order the activity asks
白天，陆地增温快，海洋增温慢——这是海陆风的起因。: In the daytime the land warms faster than the ocean; this is the cause of the sea–land breeze.
陆地上空空气上升、海洋上空下沉，近地面风由海洋吹向陆地（海风）。: Air rises over the land and sinks over the ocean, and near-surface wind blows from the ocean to the land (sea breeze).
教材图 2.13a 是留给学生填的空图；本课按活动第 1 题 (1)→(4) 的: Textbook Fig. 2.13a is a blank diagram for students to fill in; this lesson draws it layer by layer following Activity question 1 parts (1)→(4), which is the answer to that question.
去掉这一步：主线问题「两岸风向为什么反过来」缺了白天那一半。: Skip this step and the main question "why does the wind reverse" is missing its daytime half.
常考：白天吹海风（海→陆），夜晚吹陆风（陆→海）；问「风从哪来」要答近地面那一支: Often tested: sea breeze (sea→land) by day, land breeze (land→sea) by night; "where does the wind come from" refers to the near-surface branch.
白天陆地增温快、海洋增温慢，陆地空气上升、海洋空气下沉，近地面风由海洋吹向陆地。: By day the land warms faster than the ocean; air rises over land and sinks over the ocean, and the near-surface wind blows from ocean to land.
facts A2.6、A2.8（图 2.13a 图面）、B2.1 第 5 条、表: facts A2.6, A2.8 (Fig. 2.13a), B2.1 item 5, table row 1
到了夜里，风为什么反过来了？: Why does the wind reverse at night?
把「昼夜」从白天拨到夜晚：看红蓝两色整体互换、四支箭头同时掉头: Switch "Day/night" from day to night: watch red and blue swap and all four arrows turn around together
海洋（右）暖、陆地（左）冷；近地面风由陆吹向海；气压与风速读数一个都不变，只有方: Ocean (right) warm, land (left) cool; near-surface wind blows from land to sea; the pressure and wind readings stay the same, only the direction reverses
夜晚：陆地降温快 → 陆风（陆 → 海）: Night: land cools faster → land breeze (land → sea)
陆地降温快、海洋降温慢: Land cools fast, ocean cools slowly
夜晚，陆地降温快，海洋降温慢——受热的那一段换成了海洋。: At night the land cools faster than the ocean, so the heated section switches to the ocean.
四支箭头全部翻转，近地面风由陆地吹向海洋（陆风）。: All four arrows reverse, and near-surface wind blows from the land to the ocean (land breeze).
数值读数与白天完全相同：昼夜改变的是「哪一段受热」，不是环流的强弱。: The readings are exactly the same as by day: day versus night changes which section is heated, not the strength of the circulation.
去掉这一步：学生容易把「昼夜反向」记成「夜晚风更小」，而判据是方向反、数值不变。: Skip this step and students easily remember "reversal at night" as "weaker wind at night", while the rule is: direction reversed, values unchanged.
易错：以为海陆风昼夜只是强弱不同。教材讲的是方向相反。: Common mistake: thinking the sea–land breeze only differs in strength between day and night. The textbook says the directions are opposite.
夜晚陆地降温快、海洋降温慢，海洋上空上升、陆地上空下沉，近地面风由陆地吹向海洋—: At night the land cools faster than the ocean; air rises over the ocean and sinks over the land, and near-surface wind blows from land to ocean: the sea–land breeze reverses between day and night.
facts A2.6、A2.8（图 2.13b 图面）、B2.1 第 5 条、表: facts A2.6, A2.8 (Fig. 2.13b), B2.1 item 5, table row 4, D5
污染企业放在城边上，为什么污染物反而进了城？: The polluting plant is at the city's edge, so why do the pollutants end up in the city?
把「污染企业位置」从环流范围外拨到范围内：看羽流怎么拐进中心区、城区浓度指数怎么: Switch "Polluting plant location" from outside the circulation to inside it: watch the plume turn into the city center and the city concentration index jump
企业在环外时城区浓度指数 8 %；挪进环流范围后变成 45 %（风速 3.6 m: With the plant outside the loop the city concentration index is 8 %; moved inside the circulation it becomes 45 % (wind 3.6 m/s, schematic)
城市中心区升温更快，空气在中心区上升、在郊区下沉；高空气流由中心区流向郊区，近地: The city center warms faster; air rises over the center and sinks over the suburbs; upper-air flow goes from the center to the suburbs, near-surface flow from the suburbs to the center.
所以污染风险较大的工业企业若放在热岛环流范围之内，污染物会随近地面气流进入城区（: So if a high-pollution plant is placed inside the heat-island circulation, its pollutants are carried into the city by the near-surface flow (concentration index 8 % → 45 %, schematic).
城市规划时一般把这类企业布局在城市热岛环流的范围之外。: In urban planning such plants are usually placed outside the heat-island circulation.
去掉这一步：学生只会背「热岛」，说不出工业区为什么要避开城郊之间这一圈。: Skip this step and students can only recite "heat island" without explaining why industrial zones must avoid the loop between city and suburbs.
常考：城市热岛环流的近地面风由郊区吹向中心区，因此污染企业要放在环流范围之外。: Often tested: near-surface wind in the heat-island circulation blows from the suburbs to the center, so polluting plants must be placed outside the circulation.
中心区与郊区的温差形成热岛环流：中心区上升、郊区下沉，近地面风由郊区吹向中心区，: The temperature difference between the center and the suburbs forms the heat-island circulation: the center rises, the suburbs sink, near-surface wind blows from the suburbs to the center, and polluting plants must be located outside the circulation.

昼夜开关不改数值，所以「拨到夜晚」帮不上忙——题干要的是白天的海风。: The day/night switch doesn't change the values, so switching to night doesn't help; the question asks for the daytime sea breeze.
去掉这一步：学生会把「温差越大越好」当成结论，而真实大气里温差更大往往伴着更强的: Skip this step and students conclude "the bigger the temperature difference the better", while in the real atmosphere larger differences often come with stronger weather systems; this lesson's model stops at thermal circulation.

温差是环流强弱与风向的唯一驱动：温差越大，气压差越大，风越大；昼夜只改方向。: The temperature difference is the only driver of circulation strength and wind direction: the larger it is, the larger the pressure difference and the stronger the wind; day and night only change the direction.

大气热力环流的起因是: The cause of atmospheric thermal circulation is
由于地面冷热不均而形成的空气环流，称为大气热力环流。: Air circulation formed because the ground is heated unevenly is called atmospheric thermal circulation.
受热处（A 地）近地面的气压是: Near the surface over the heated area (A), the pressure is
A 地空气上升向外流出后密度减小，近地面形成低气压；上空才是高气压。: After the air at A rises and flows outward its density falls, forming low pressure near the surface; the high pressure is aloft.
同一段地面上，高空与近地面的气压符号: Over the same section of ground, the pressure signs aloft and near the surface are
受热处近地面低压、上高高（相对）；等压面因此近地面下凹、高空上凸。: Over the heated area: low pressure near the surface, high aloft (relative); so the isobaric surfaces dip near the surface and bulge aloft.
热力环流的形成顺序是: The order in which thermal circulation forms is
水平运动 → 垂直运动 → 气压差: Horizontal motion → vertical motion → pressure difference
冷热不均 → 垂直运动 → 同一水平面气压差 → 水平运动: Uneven heating → vertical motion → pressure difference on the same level → horizontal motion
气压差 → 冷热不均 → 水平运动: Pressure difference → uneven heating → horizontal motion
冷热不均 → 水平运动 → 垂直运动: Uneven heating → horizontal motion → vertical motion
地面受热不均先造成升降，才使同一水平面出现气压差，最后才有水平运动。: Uneven heating first causes rising and sinking, which then creates pressure differences on the same level, and only then comes horizontal motion.
由低压流向高压: From low pressure to high pressure
水平气压梯度力促使大气由高压区流向低压区，这是形成风的直接原因。: The horizontal pressure gradient force pushes air from high pressure to low pressure; this is the direct cause of wind.
白天台湾海峡近地面的风由: By day, near-surface wind over the Taiwan Strait blows
两侧向中间吹: From both sides toward the middle
白天陆地增温快、海洋增温慢，陆地上升、海洋下沉，近地面风由海洋吹向陆地（海风）。: By day the land warms faster than the ocean; air rises over land and sinks over the ocean, and near-surface wind blows from ocean to land (sea breeze).
夜晚的海陆风与白天相比: Compared with daytime, the sea–land breeze at night is
夜晚陆地降温快、海洋降温慢，受热的那一段换了，近地面风由陆地吹向海洋（陆风）。: At night the land cools faster than the ocean, so the heated section changes and near-surface wind blows from land to ocean (land breeze).
城市热岛环流中，近地面气流的方向是: In urban heat-island circulation, near-surface air flows
由中心区流向郊区: From the center to the suburbs
由郊区流向中心区: From the suburbs to the center
中心区上升、郊区下沉，高空气流由中心区流向郊区，近地面气流由郊区流向中心区——所: The center rises and the suburbs sink; upper-air flow goes from the center to the suburbs and near-surface flow from the suburbs to the center, so polluting plants must be placed outside the circulation.
